pages.text: $(thing)Northern Corn Leaf Blight$() ($(o)Exserohilum turcicum$()), fungus.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() maize, sorghum.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() crop residue, airborne spores.
$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 18-27 °C (best 24 °C), humidity above 85%, 6 h of wet leaves.
$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 1 years (residue).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 40% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Rotation; Plough down residue; Resistant hybrids (Ht genes).
